answer: The garden holds work receipts rather than names, so the forge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The vault of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
